sentences.text: It is submitted that the petitioner is neither an accused person nor the charge-sheeted accused person, nor its land was under investigation to the knowledge of this petition.
However, it is found that he is unable to alienate or take any steps in regard to the land mentioned therein in the application.
Accordingly, he has come before this Court by setting aside the order.
Heard the submissions on behalf of the petitioner and perused the records.

Considering the report of Inspector, DDI, Murshidabad DD, CID, West Bengal dated March 24,
2025, the prayer of the applicant was kept in abeyance til the disposal fo the WPA (P) 493 of 2022.
It prima facie, transpires that one writ petition before this Court, where also he is no way connected to the said proceedings.
In view of the above, the petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this revisional application upon the opposite party/State.
Let the matter appear in the monthly list of November, 2025 and be placed before the regular Bench.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
